# Contributing to InputConfig

Thank you for helping. InputConfig is built and maintained by one person, so the most useful things
are clear bug reports and focused ideas.

## Bugs

Open an issue with the **Bug report** form. Include the InputConfig version (in the About window), your
macOS version and Mac model, what you did, what you expected, and what happened instead. A
screenshot or a short screen recording helps a lot.

## Ideas

Open an issue with the **Feature request** form and describe what you are trying to do, not only
the feature you have in mind. That makes it easier to find the right fix.

## Code

For anything larger than a small fix, open an issue first so we can agree on the approach. Keep
pull requests to one change, match the style of the code around it, and build and test on the
oldest macOS the app supports. By contributing you agree that your work is released under this
repository's license.

## Security

Please do not report security issues in public. See the [security policy](SECURITY.md).

Help for using the app is at [inputconfig.com/help](https://inputconfig.com/help/).
